title: Story premise EDU095: The Price Tag Has a Second Floor
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: Is the smaller number also the smaller total? Takeaway/theme: Compare the complete stated price and commitment, not just the headline number.
description: A buyer wants to compare two fictional one-time offers, but one displayed price omits a mandatory fee shown later. Expanding both into itemized totals reveals the actual arithmetic before any purchase choice.
